plugins.name: paypal-sdk
plugins.description: Install and consume the PayPal .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. A single paypal-sdk agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the integrate-paypal router + the paypal-sdk agent. No MCP server. (Do not install alongside acp-paypal — the integrate-paypal skill name collides.)
